label: NieR
about: Ink on parchment, or parchment on ink: rules, brackets, square marks, hatching and line drawings. NieR Mode's eight ink scenes stay its own background choice.

wallpapers.name: Archive
wallpapers.description: An archive page: a hatched header, a menu list, a level gauge and corner brackets.

wallpapers.name: Signal
wallpapers.description: A scanner's rings, ticks and sweep at the lower right, crosshairs across the sheet.

wallpapers.name: Fragments
wallpapers.description: Squares streaming from two corners as something comes apart.

wallpapers.name: Hatch
wallpapers.description: Two bands of diagonal hatching across opposite corners over a dotted grid.

wallpapers.name: Flora
wallpapers.description: Line drawings of grass, flowers, ferns and a vine along the edges, seeds drifting.
